<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_SubrogationRecourse" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/subrogation-recourse">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SubrogationRecourse" name="Subrogation Recourse Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CaseReceived" name="Possible subrogation identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToObtain</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInfo" name="Obtain information about possible subrogation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToObtain</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ObtainToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ObtainToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToRecoursePossible</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible_Split" name="Is recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToRecoursePossible</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecourseNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecourseYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseNoRecourse" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecourseNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClosedNoRecourse" name="Case closed (no recourse possible)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseNoRecourseToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecourseYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestToReminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestToReminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReminderToEventGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AfterReminder_Split" name="What happens after reminder?" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReminderToEventGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGatewayToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGatewayToDisagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGatewayToDeadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGatewayToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_PaymentReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentToBooking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BookingToClosePaid</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClosePaid" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BookingToClosePaid</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClosePaidToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClosedPaid" name="Case closed (payment received)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClosePaidToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Disagreement" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGatewayToDisagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisagreementToCheckReasoning</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check insurant's reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisagreementToCheckReasoning</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReasoningToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReasoningCheck_Split" name="Is insurant's reasoning right?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReasoningToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseDisagreement" name="Close case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseDisagreementToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClosedDisagreement" name="Case closed (insurant right)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseDisagreementToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_DeadlineReached" name="Deadline for disagreement reached without payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGatewayToDeadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeadlineToCollectionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_DisagreementDeadline">
        <bpmn:documentation>Deadline for disagreement; the duration is not specified in the description.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CollectionMerge_Join" name="Collection agency case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReasoningWrong</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeadlineToCollectionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToForward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ForwardToCollection" name="Forward case to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToForward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ForwardedToCollection" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForwardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToObtain" sourceRef="StartEvent_CaseReceived" targetRef="Task_ObtainInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ObtainToCheck" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInfo" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToRecoursePossible" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible_Split" targetRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseNoRecourseToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseNoRecourse" targetRef="EndEvent_ClosedNoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible_Split" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToReminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderToEventGateway" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AfterReminder_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGatewayToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterReminder_Split" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGatewayToDisagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterReminder_Split" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGatewayToDeadline" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterReminder_Split" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToBooking" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BookingToClosePaid" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Task_ClosePaid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClosePaidToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ClosePaid" targetRef="EndEvent_ClosedPaid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisagreementToCheckReasoning" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Disagreement" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReasoningToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_ReasoningCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningRight" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_CloseDisagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseDisagreementToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CloseDisagreement" targetRef="EndEvent_ClosedDisagreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReasoningWrong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReasoningCheck_Split" targetRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeadlineToCollectionMerge" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToForward" sourceRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge_Join" targetRef="Task_ForwardToCollection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCollection" targetRef="EndEvent_ForwardedToCollection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
